name: @eagle-to-figjam/eagle-plugin
description: Eagle plugin that serves selected images over a localhost bridge for the FigJam companion to pull.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node16 --external:sharp --outfile=dist/main.js && cp src/ui.html dist/ui.html && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && (cp logo.png dist/logo.png 2>/dev/null || true)
